method: Static optical-core build. All six instruments rotated once per minute at 1920 × 1080; sampled every 10 seconds. Later preset, balance and media edits were verified separately. FPS samples exclude brief deliberate context interruptions.
renderer: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M2 Max, Unspecified Version)
limitations: Measures JS heap and accounted render-target allocations, not total browser process or GPU driver memory. Context restoration reseeds the optical simulation; it does not recover discarded unsaved textures.
